cv_grouping.rule: every evaluable grouping (replicate clusters or the declared group, plus batch, lot, plate, date, round and scale columns and campaign rounds) is cross-validated; the lowest held-out Spearman drives cv_spearman, the reliability verdict and the conformal calibration

selection_aware.score: abs(y - mu_oof) / sigma_oof over the selected held-out runs
selection_aware.selection: in every fold of every CV repeat, the ceil(top_fraction * n_fold) held-out runs the fold model ranked best (highest prediction; lowest when minimizing)
selection_aware.coverage_guarantee: none: held-out top-ranked runs are a proxy for proposals and the pooled repeats are correlated; the coverage at proposals is measured in simulation and shipped with the band

interval_method.quantile: k-th smallest score, k = ceil((n + 1) * coverage)
interval_method.coverage_guarantee: approximate: out-of-fold scores come from grouped-CV fold models and are not exactly exchangeable with a proposal from the full-data model
interval_method.empirical_oof_coverage_note: in-sample: counted on the same scores that set q_norm, so it is >= rank / n by construction; coverage_by_sigma_half shows whether the band adapts to the model's sd

gp_posterior.gp_intervals: observation (latent + observation noise), one new measurement
gp_posterior.quantiles: observation (latent + observation noise), one new measurement
gp_posterior.p_improve: latent mean (no observation noise): P(the model's mean beats the incumbent), not P(one new measurement beats it)
gp_posterior.incumbent: the value the proposal annotation compares against (best single measurement, or best replicate-averaged recipe mean when the replicate-aware surrogate proposed); analytic EI is reported for ranking context, the batch itself was chosen by qLogNEI

verdict.headline: Kalos put your past runs in the right order, with enough runs to check the ranking, so its suggestions are worth running.

ordering.plain: The model put past runs it had not seen in the right order most of the time.

range_width.plain: The likely range is too narrow: fewer results land inside it than it promises.

verdict.rule: Refused: no held-out score, fewer than 3 groups of runs, or the upper end of the score's 95% interval at or below 0. Reliable: score at or above the floor, the lower end of its 95% interval above 0, at least 20 runs and 8 groups of runs. Not yet: everything else.

proposal_gating.reason: feasibility classifier did not fit (cold-start fallback: too few non-producer examples to train on); not zero-inflated enough: n_infeasible=0 < 5; feasibility CV AUC not measurable on this sheet

cv_group_mean_baseline.interpretation: A model whose CV Spearman does not clearly beat this floor may be recognizing recipes, not modeling the process.
